thread:
tess: Heads-up: we're opening a pricing experiment for price_v3. Need a single owner thread for CSV schema, grandfather logic, AR triggers, and vendor carve-outs. Goal: 5% canary, 7 days.

omar: I can own ingestion changes. Proposed CSV additions: rate_code, grandfather_until (epoch), retro_opt_in (bool), manual_review_flag, review_id.

lucy: For A/B: A = v2, B = v3 tiered. Exclude: reserved capacity and contracts with vendor lock clauses. I'll produce cohort SQL + exclude list.

paul: Legal: any contract with a "no-retro" or minimum-commitment clause must be excluded or get written consent. I'll return a list of contract IDs and suggested customer messaging.

devon: AR needs automation: any invoice delta > $1.2k or pct delta > 25% flagged. We want a CSV export and auto-ticketing. Also prefer an "AR-PRIO" tag for high-value items.

omar: Sample CSV row for ingest: 

```
account_id,rate_code,quantity,grandfather_until,retro_opt_in,manual_review_flag,review_id
ACC-77,price_v3_t1,150,0,true,false,
```

oma-bot: billing-bot checklist: schema-validate, webhook-emitter, staging-sim-invoices, cohort-exclude, legal-carveouts. All tests must pass in staging.

tess: Gating criteria for moving from canary -> wide: staging sim invoice success rate > 99.5%, median invoice delta < 10%, manual-review queue < 75 items, estimated retro liability < $8k. Rollback triggers documented.

lucy: I'll also add a delayed-ingestion exclude (accounts with >48hr backfill). Will share counts so sample size is accurate.

paul: I'll draft the legal customer text for grandfathering and retro credits; will post in the PR.

omar: I'll open the PR with schema + webhook + small sim harness. PR link will be posted here.

devon: AR sheet template: https://sheets.redwood.co/AR-PRICING-REVIEW-2180 with columns: review_id,acct,old_amount,new_amount,delta_pct,owner,status. Will wire webhook->ticket creation.

tess: Approvals needed before canary: Legal (Paul), RevOps (Lucy), Finance Lead. Timeline: final schema by EOD Thu (2180110000), staging test Fri, canary Mon (2180714800).

omar: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/billing/compare/price-v3-schema. Running schema tests now.

tess: Great. Keep updates here. If legal carve-outs >30 accounts we may delay to add manual process. :eyes:
